items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I think I made records for Bennett Jeanette.

ctx.x: But you don't see male impersonators.
Oh, well now, I tell you the male impersonator that was popular in the early '20's, a girl -- it was a team called Seymour and Jeannette. Jeannette was a male impersonator, but he was Seymour was --
